name: Valerie
source:
Tucker and Ross met Valerie in computer science club in freshman year, and the trio have been inseparable ever since. Val has no trouble keeping up with the boys’ hacking skills, although she tends to take a more disciplined approach to things, keeping her friends’ sometimes juvenile behavior under control.

Despite her relative maturity, she can be a bit of a space cadet sometimes, often daydreaming and completely missing the point of things. She always knows how to keep spirits up and deal with a variety of personalities, though, acting as the glue that holds the group together.
